a.text: I'll honor our agreement and operate in round 1. The reserve has 4 now, which is only enough for one of us. I won't take behind your back. If you want to renegotiate, say so openly and we can decide together. Otherwise I'm sticking to the plan.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.
